prompt: Story and quest: A tiny apprentice witch must help Barnaby, an elderly seagull scholar whose ancient navigation map was blown away by a midnight storm. To help him remember the lost sea route, she plans to brew the legendary Potion of Golden Sight. Barnaby guides her through a gentle coastal mystery: glowing sea herbs grow beside the cliffside tide pools, a ripe Golden Carrot waits in her storm-damaged farm plot, and an old copper cauldron stands inside the coastal windmill workshop. Frame this as a polished narrative exploration scene with a clear objective and purposeful dialogue, using the quest as environmental storytelling rather than requiring inventory, item counters, harvesting mechanics, interactive popups, a brewing mini-game, a timer, or multiple gameplay states. The player should be able to explore the environment, speak with Barnaby, and understand the intended sea-herb, carrot, and cauldron journey from the map composition and dialogue alone. Map composition: Build one compact, richly detailed, readable coastal farm map. Keep the small lived-in timber cottage and windmill workshop in the upper-left farm area; place four tidy cultivated plots with golden carrots, sea herbs, pumpkins, flowers, a rain barrel, fruit trees, and short split-rail fences nearby; create a broad sandy walking path through the center; place Barnaby near a modest wooden pier; and show turquoise tide pools, rugged low cliffs, glowing coastal herbs, detailed wave foam, and the open sea along the lower and right edges. Connect every landmark with continuous walkable ground and a visually obvious route from cottage to fields to Barnaby to workshop. Keep the farm, house, workshop, cliffs, pier, and sea visible together at an intimate cozy-farming-RPG scale. Buildings must remain one-story and human-scale, scenery must not overwhelm the player, and important landmarks must not be hidden behind decorative objects. Use restrained sage green, warm cream, dusty teal, weathered blue, soft lavender, and one muted golden accent under gentle dawn light; avoid excessive saturation, muddy brown dominance, giant empty spaces, cinematic panorama composition, and oversized architecture. Player appearance: chibi yordle witch inspired by Lulu, 1.5-head-tall proportions, a massive floppy pale blush-pink pointed witch hat wider than her body with a broad soft brim and a gently drooping curved tip, matching the elegant soft dusty-rose shape of a classic oversized storybook witch hat; fluffy muted rose-mauve anime bangs, cute pointed furry elf ears poking out sideways, absolutely NO visible neck, tiny compact round body, large expressive dot-matrix anime eyes, and a small crooked dark-brown magical staff. Her outfit must use clearly separated colors rather than one monochrome pink mass: pale blush-pink hat, muted rose-mauve hair, soft lavender capelet, deep indigo inner dress, warm cream collar, restrained golden star trim, brown leather satchel and staff, and charcoal-purple tiny shoes. Keep the pale pink gentle and low-saturation, with cream highlights and mauve shadows; do not use hot magenta, neon pink, or the same pink tone for her hat, hair, face, cloak, dress, and shoes. Preserve this player appearance exactly and consistently across every player sprite and avatar. Barnaby appearance: an elderly, friendly seagull scholar wearing a faded navy sailor cap, tiny round spectacles, and a weathered satchel containing rolled map fragments. Dialogue: Barnaby explains that the storm scattered his map and points out the glowing sea herbs, Golden Carrot, and windmill cauldron; the little witch promises to follow the coastal route and brew the potion before dusk. Keep all dialogue concise, warm, and consistent with the visible landmarks. Combat encounter: Include exactly two small non-humanoid coastal crab minions in this scene, with distinct ids tidepool-crab and shell-crab, and list BOTH ids in the scene minionIds. Tidepool Crab has a muted coral-orange shell and Shell Crab has a dusty turquoise shell; both have two obvious claws, small dark eyes on stalks, short sideways legs, and clean compact crab silhouettes. These are animals, never witches or humanoids: no hat, cloak, staff, hair, or human face. Give each crab hp 24, attack 4, defense 2, and give the witch hp 100, attack 16, defense 8 for a gentle winnable battle. Describe them as mischievous guardians near the walkable coastal path, not as scenery painted into the background. Barnaby should mention that the witch can confront the two little crabs using her staff while looking for sea herbs. Preserve the witch appearance, farming plots, house, seaside map and all other story details unchanged.
